# Chapter 1: Measurement

The relation is illustrated below.

Evidence definition: calibration compares a measurement with a reference, not with truth known without error.

Evidence assumption: independent errors with finite variance permit the variance-of-the-mean formula.

$$
\operatorname{Var}(\bar X) = \sigma^2 / n
$$

Evidence example: four independent readings with variance nine give a mean with variance 2.25.
